issue_context.title: *: Improve point get performance for max ts optimization
issue_context.body:
## Enhancement

Now we are using `math.MaxUint64` as point get's read ts in an autocommit txn. In current implement, we still need to activate the inner transaction  which will introduce some additional cost. We can avoid activating a new txn in above scene  to save the cost.

review_comments: How about making it part of the `prepareTxn` function?
`WarmUp` will call `prepareTxn` , if we move it to `prepareTxn` it will still cost some cpu to when `WarmUp`
Would an extra `TsFuture` be processed in the `prepareTxn` function, as next `replaceTxnTsFuture` seems to `replace` it?

Yes. replaceTxnTsFuture will force replace the txn future, the caller will ensure the correctness. Because `replaceTxnTsFuture` is a private method which can only be called by provider, it is not a big problem
Notice that we should guarantee that the outer code should NOT make an assumption that the txn is activated after `GetStmtReadTS` when we are using the maxTS optimization for point get.
